points.text: Fixed a memory leak from enemy health bars and attack warnings.
Hopping and flying enemies now rise off the ground instead of staying pinned to it.
Player and enemy hitboxes now match their height and feet.
An opened boss door no longer offers an interact prompt.
Anvil: switching tabs mid-forge cancels the forge so the materials you paid are not lost.
Anvil analyze: shows the result and stays open so you can analyze more items.
Fixed a memory leak when aiming on the crystal map.

entries.summary: Bug fixes for combat leaks, collisions, the boss door and the anvil.

points.text: Metal HUD strip with a mana bar under HP and a threat gem on the right. A special does not start when mana is short. Orbs, potions, and food restore mana. Settings can hide the gem.

Hold potions and food between dives. The stall sells three different potions each visit and food you can stack or buy as a new kind. Placeholdia keeps up to three potions and six kinds of food. One potion and one food stack go Below with you. The dumpster has moldy bread on a fresh save (and another if you took the last one). Vendor rows are pale price tags; the stall has a wooden crate and red jar; moldy bread and root stew have their own icons.
Ghost shop uses a pale cloth counter. Snack, artifact, and pawn rows are light shelves with an icon on the right.
Enemy drops retuned. Keyed HP orbs, mana orbs, and coin pickups roll per kill.
Mid-run quit or crash stores the run as lost: worn run loot and the run root do not survive.
Loading bars fill smoothly with weighted milestones, creep, and per-frame sub-progress. 100% only at finish. Loader weights are per-platform and learned.
Dungeon shadows fixed (cast and enemy grids were empty).
UI restyle passes: crystal buttons match transport pages, tooltips/slot/anvil pickers/confirms/scroll bars follow the host skin, dark text has no outline, crystal focus ring brighter.
Web music streams and plays off the frame loop (HTMLAudio → Web Audio).
Torches: hall cadence fills only dark stretches; light cap raised so the ring lights every torch. Dungeon arrival builds the full light plan under the cover.

entries.summary: Metal HUD with mana and a danger gem, potions and food persist between dives, ghost shop and vendor got their own fronts and icons, loading and lighting cleaned up.
